title: Drama billboard / Full composition
slide_intent: Use a series of programme images to substantiate a broad promise so the claim is visible rather than abstract.
strategic_value: Channel 4’s drama message can gain credibility from several recognizable titles beside the green brand panel.
demonstration: A wide outdoor billboard shows It’s just one drama after another beside three programme images, viewed within its street surroundings.
practical_value: Compare the full billboard with C407’s close detail to judge hierarchy at a distance.

content_islands.name: Brand promise
content_islands.spec: Keep the green headline panel and leading mark at the left.

content_islands.name: Programme range
content_islands.spec: Place three adjacent drama images to the right with small titles and colored lower regions.

content_islands.name: Street context
content_islands.spec: Retain the fence and buildings to establish scale.

reference_purposes.Application: The wide billboard demonstrates the identity and multiple drama titles in an outdoor setting.
